_: Wed 4 Nov 2026, SELLER card, final words from _WEEK-TEXT.md. Metro Atlanta rows of the Redfin weekly report released Oct 29 2026 (four weeks ending Oct 25): new listings down 26.5 percent and pending sales down 25.9 percent vs a year earlier. Both figures were read on a copy of the release in an earlier pass and not re-opened in this pass. No percent was worked out by us. Source appears only in the bottom line. No verdict, no prediction, no price on any home.
headline:
Selling In South Metro
Atlanta Listings Down 26.5%
turn_1: Echo, fewer homes are coming up for sale in metro Atlanta. New listings were down 26.5% from a year ago, over the four weeks ending Oct 25.
turn_2: So what does that mean for a seller?
turn_3: A seller has fewer new homes competing for buyers. Homes going under contract fell 25.9%, so fewer buyers are signing on too.
echo_line: So fewer new homes to pick from and fewer buyers signing. I can barely pick a lunch spot.
source: Redfin weekly housing report · four weeks ending Oct 25, 2026 · released Oct 29, 2026
disclaimer: Metro Atlanta figures compared with a year earlier, not a valuation of any home. Results differ by county, price range and condition.
